coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded recall only; nationwide Food Line production collector remains authoritative.
All 12 targeted web searches completed and returned responses; no search-level errors surfaced.
No qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was independently verified as newly reported or newly effective within the observation window.

Grocery and disaster results were older fires, historic closures, reopening reports, or not a sole/full-service grocery loss; weather coverage did not evidence new cancellation of emergency food distributions.
Pantry results included dated older service losses and 2026 storm-related food losses outside the window, but no newly verified abrupt closure/service reduction.

SNAP/WIC outage searches predominantly returned October-November 2025 government-shutdown notices, dated older 2026 service stories, or generic EBT guides. These were excluded as stale or non-qualifying.
Search indexing can lag highly localized service announcements; no_findings denotes no verified fresh qualifying signal rather than absence of incidents.
No approvals, publications, collector changes, schedule changes, or task disabling occurred.
